body: @Seldaek , ping, I guess you can fix it quick and easy =)
Sorry but no idea, it might actually be a bug. Not sure why it would be caused by my changes though, but it's not impossible.

@Seldaek For the alias, your optimized method calls `getFooService` directly, thus creating a new `foo` service. Previously, it was using `getAliasForFooService` which was calling `get('foo')` (thus keeping the scoped instance).

Note that this will also happen for container-scoped services
btw, it would also break if you alias a synthetic service. Aliases should still call `->get($originalId)` to support all cases.
Alternatively we could have a map of aliases to avoid calling the getAliasId() method?

issue.title: UniqueValidator with getUser() on symfony 2.3
issue.body:
I just upgraded to symfony 2.3 and I'm getting a strange error.

Getting the user from the controller->getUser method, in my controller I execute:

```
$user = $this->getUser();
$errors = $this->container->get('validator')->validate($user);
var_dump((string)$errors);
```

The output says that the email (the field I'm using with the unique validator) is in use.

```
UniqueEntity(fields="email", message="errors.user.email.unique_entity")
```

This worked fine with symfony 2.2.

issue.title: Service with aliases goes wrong
issue.body:
DoctrineMongoDBExtension provides service **'doctrine_mongodb.odm.default_document_manager'** and alias **'doctrine.odm.mongodb.document_manager'** for BC. But Container does not save service in cache under alias id.

So, when I do 
**$this->getContainer()->get('doctrine.odm.mongodb.document_manager');** more then once, Container creates new **DocumentManager**, which creates new **UnitOfWork**. This causes big troubles, when I try to save some document in different classes via different **DocumentManager**s.

Solution: ContainerBuilder must include all aliases in DI cache build:

> $this->services['doctrine_mongodb.odm.default_document_manager'] = **$this->services['doctrine.odm.mongodb.document_manager'] =** $instance = call_user_func(array('Doctrine\ODM\MongoDB\DocumentManager', 'create'), $this->get('doctrine_mongodb.odm.default_connection'), $this->get('doctrine_mongodb.odm.default_configuration'), $this->get('doctrine_mongodb.odm.event_manager'));

issue.title: Symfony 2.3 DIC "has" method does not work on aliases anymore
issue.body:
hello! 
After upgrading the DI-Container from Symfony 2.1 to Symfony 2.3 the method has does not return true for alias services anymore. 

The has method checks for services or getter methods in the di container, but somehow the aliases are not checked anymore.
